autoDetail: An unnamed task is named after its first message and checked once after the first run. Later it is renamed only when the task clearly changes direction. A task the AI teammate proposed keeps the title it was proposed with and is likewise renamed only when its direction changes
fallback: This deployment can't name tasks automatically, so the AI teammate names a task once it understands it
intro: Tasks someone has renamed are never renamed automatically
label: Task names
manualDetail: No automatic names. New tasks stay "New task" until someone renames them
